question: Does quantizing 盈縮加分 M to four decimals after EACH day, while retaining the candidate extra 1/4 last micro in the unquantized 日差 short increment S, also reproduce the two-season original G893 M values?

source.physical: Kyujanggak 奎貴893 GK00893_00 (one physical copy only)
source.archive_origin: Previously registered 13MI original-source Action artifact; images verified again by SHA-256

integer_model.equation: M_micro[0]=M4[0]*100; S_micro[0]=S4[0]*100; M_micro[n+1]=100*Q((M_micro[n]-S_micro[n])/100); S_micro[n+1]=S_micro[n]+d_micro; Q=positive FLOOR or HALF_UP. Record original-source M4[n] at sampled days.
integer_model.hypothesis: Retain the hypothetical high-precision quarter-micro tail in S without daily S4 truncation; round only M at every daily transition (not just at final sample).
integer_model.rounding_placement_warning: 13SB per-step S4 quantization and this per-step M4 quantization are materially different models. The phrase 'quantize every day' cannot identify which variable or when.

comparison.conclusion: Both fully specified retained-tail models with per-day M4-only quantization contradict the 28 sampled source-original M observations in both seasons. Excludes only these operationally specified models; not all possible intermediate carrying/rounding schemes.
comparison.preserved_survivor: 13SB shows that quantizing the short-increment S to S4 at each transition can mask hypothetical trailing micro digits in 28/28 pairs; retained-tail M-only rounding does not. This is a contrast of test-defined algorithms, not evidence for a historical winner.
